subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Cooking, like many things, requires attention before action.”?
options: Fixing a mistake can take more work than avoiding one.
They simply open the door and take what they need.
Every success stands on many ideas that did not work.
Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Cooking, like many things, requires attention before action. Fixing a mistake can take more work than avoiding one.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「They simply open the door and take what they need.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Every success stands on many ideas that did not work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Respecting digital work means respecting the person who made it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Cooking, like many things, requires attention before action. Fixing a mistake can take more work than avoiding one.」，答案為「Fixing a mistake can take more work than avoiding one.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Fixing a mistake can take more work than avoiding one.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
